```artifact
Feature: User Authentication and System Administration

  Scenario: Valid User Login
    Given a valid username and password
    When the user attempts to log in
    Then the user is granted access to the System

  Scenario: Invalid User Login
    Given an invalid username and password
    When the user attempts to log in
    Then the user is denied access to the System

  Scenario: Administrator Login
    Given the Administrator's username and password
    When the Administrator attempts to log in
    Then the Administrator is granted access to the System Administrator Screens

  Scenario: Maintain Speciality
    Given a valid Speciality Id
    When the Administrator attempts to add a Speciality
    Then the Speciality is added to the System

  Scenario: Edit/Update Speciality
    Given a valid Speciality Id
    When the Administrator attempts to edit a Speciality
    Then the Speciality is updated in the System

  Scenario: Create Users
    Given a valid Doctor's username and password
    When the Administrator attempts to create a Doctor
    Then the Doctor is created in the System

  Scenario: Create Users - Chemists and Labs
    Given a valid Chemist's username and password
    When the Administrator attempts to create a Chemist
    Then the Chemist is created in the System

  Scenario: Administrator Screens
    Given the Administrator's username and password
    When the Administrator accesses the System Administrator Screens
    Then the Administrator can view and interact with the screens

  Scenario Outline: Speciality Management
    Given a valid Speciality Id
    When the Administrator attempts to <action>
    Then the Speciality is <result> in the System

    Examples:
      | action | result |
      | add    | added  |
      | edit   | updated|
      | delete | deleted|

  Scenario Outline: User Management
    Given a valid username and password
    When the Administrator attempts to <action>
    Then the user is <result> in the System

    Examples:
      | action | result |
      | create | created|
      | edit   | updated|
      | delete | deleted|
```
